title: Quick Start, Episode 7: Crimes... And Felonies.
summary: Cathode Ray Dude covers two bizarre HP 'Quick Start' features: QuickLook, an offline email client built on EFI firmware, and Daystarter, which hijacks the Windows boot process. It includes an explanation of EFI applications and why HP built these things.
why: Cited as a deep, entertaining look at firmware-level software and vendors abusing pre-boot access.

quote.text: a brief history of quick boot operating systems and UEFI
